record.question: HbA1C cut off for diagnosis of diabetes is:
record.explanation: Answer C: 6.5. The diagnostic HbA1c threshold is ≥6.5% when measured with a standardized assay and interpreted under diagnostic criteria; confirmation is generally required without unequivocal hyperglycemia. Reference: https://diabetesjournals.org/care/article/49/Supplement_1/S27/163926/2-Diagnosis-and-Classification-of-Diabetes. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
